## Crystal Dragon, Old (CR 13)

**XP** 25,600  
 CG Huge dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +0; **Senses** dragon senses, tremorsense 120 ft.; Perception +24; **Aura** frightful presence (240 ft., DC 25)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 31, touch 8, flat-footed 31 (+23 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 212 (17d12+102)  
 **Fort** +18, **Ref** +12, **Will** +14  
 **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** paralysis, sleep, sonic; **SR** 24  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., burrow 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor)  
 **Melee** bite +24 (2d8+12/19-20), 2 claws +23 (2d6+8), tail slap +21 (2d6+12), 2 wings +21 (1d8+4)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (50-ft. cone, 16d4 sonic, DC 24), crush (2d8+12, DC 24)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 17th; concentration +24)  

  At will—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 18), *[glitterdust](../../magic/spells/glitterdust.md)* (DC 19), *[rainbow pattern](../../magic/spells/rainbow-pattern.md)* (DC 21)  
 3/day—*[stone to flesh](../../magic/spells/stone-to-flesh.md)* (DC 23)  

 **Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 5th; concentration +12)  

  2nd (6/day)—*[minor image](../../magic/spells/minor-image.md)* (DC 19), *[mirror image](../../magic/spells/mirror-image.md)*  
 1st (8/day)—*[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*, *[magic aura](../../magic/spells/magic-aura.md)*, *[silent image](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)* (DC 18), *[unseen servant](../../magic/spells/unseen-servant.md)*  
 0 (at will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*, *[touch of fatigue](../../magic/spells/touch-of-fatigue.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 27, **Dex** 10, **Con** 23, **Int** 18, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 24  
 **Base Atk** +17; **CMB** +27; **CMD** 37 (41 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite)  
 **Skills** Bluff +31, Climb +36, Disguise +28, Fly +12, Intimidate +27, Knowledge (dungeoneering, geography) +24, Perception +24, Sense Motive +24, Stealth +12; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Climb  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Terran, Undercommon  
 **SQ** razor sharp  

**Special Abilities**

 **Razor Sharp (Sp)**  All of a crystal dragon’s natural attacks deal slashing damage.  

  
  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground (Plane of Earth)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
